why: A is isOrientableSection'_iff_exists ∧ isOrientableSection_iff (universes 0), stated under tameness, bump functions, tame germ data and sc⁺-sections through points. B ⇒ A works by glue: B's (2) applied to Γ_f = orFunctorMap gives 6.38 ⇔ text-6.39, B's (1) gives text-6.39 ⇔ project-6.39. B's IsGammaF holds because the project's (∗) on all open sets restricts to the contractible ones. A ⇒ B fails at exactly one implication of B's (1), IsOrientableSection' → D639, and through it at D638 Γ → D639 in B's (2). The project's orientable neighbourhood is a pair V ⊆ U (paths between smooth points of V run in U). B's is one open U that is sc-smoothly contractible (H : ℝ¹×X → X with H([0,1]×U) ⊆ U). Going from a pair to B's notion needs an sc-smoothly contractible open U' with x ∈ U' ⊆ V. U' would then inherit the local propagation property and the continuity, so it would need a basis of sc-smoothly contractible neighbourhoods at smooth points. That is real mathematics, unproved in the project, and its truth for general M-polyfolds is open here (contracting r(V') by r(ty) only contracts a small V inside a larger U). Every other piece is glue and is proved. D639 → IsOrientableSection' holds because a contractible U joins its smooth points by sc-smooth paths in U (isOrientableSection'_of_D639). Under A's extra hypotheses, D639 → D638 Γ holds for every IsGammaF family Γ (D638_of_D639_of_A, using uniqueness of Γ_f on the contractible cover). A also could not be applied in B's (2) as stated, which omits bump functions, tame germ data and HasScPlusSectionsThrough. Satisfiability: B's IsGammaF is satisfied by orFunctorMap under A's hypotheses. D639 needs contractible neighbourhoods with the propagation property; these exist in finite-dimensional examples but are not known in general.
overlap: B_to_A shares 4311 project theorems with the item's proofs, essentially the whole Γ_f construction (orLocalTransport, orFunctorMap_comp, theorem_6_6_11 and the Chapter 3–6 machinery under it) plus isOrientableSection_iff_exists, which it calls directly. It does not reuse the core lemmas of the project's 6.38 ⇔ 6.39 proof (orFunctorMap_apply_eq_of_local, isContinuousOrientation_of_apply_eq, exists_isOrientableNbhd).
